name: Steamed Kohlrabi Cubes (Deeply Peeled & Boiled Soft)
whyItWorks: Sweet brassica bulb peeled deeply with a paring knife to remove all woody fibrous rind, cubed small, and boiled until fork-tender. Mild broccoli-like sweetness without rough stalks.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Cut top and bottom flat, deeply trim off fibrous outer rind until pure pale flesh is visible. Dice small and steam or boil for 15 minutes until soft.
